blurb: A two-seat snowmobile that skims over snow (hover handling): a driver and a passenger with their own gun

notes.model: "Snowmobile" by roygbpjyt (Meshy Community, CC0; content/guns.json pack meshy-community-snowmobile): 3.0 m long, 1.31 m across the skis, 1.15 m to the top of the windscreen, skis ahead (+Z) and the track behind. It replaced the Kenney Holiday Kit long sled on 2026-11-04.
notes.half: The body is 3.0 m long and 1.31 m wide at the skis (0.72 m along the seat and track); the box stops at 1.1 m, just under the windscreen's top (1.15 m).
notes.seats: Measured on the model (top-down height map of the built mesh): one long saddle from z -0.2 to -1.3, 0.55 m up where the driver sits and rising to 0.7 m at the back; the handlebars across at z -0.1, 1.1 m up; running boards 0.43 m up either side of the tunnel and footwells 0.36 m up at z 0 to 0.1. Both riders sit astride (`straddle`: thighs turned out either side of the saddle, 0.25-0.3 rad, enough for the knees to clear the side panels without splaying past the running boards), the driver's hips at z -0.55, the passenger's behind at z -1.02 on the rise. A small `legDrop` (0.1, 0.14) bends the shins forward so the driver's feet rest in the footwells under the front of the hood (0.36 m up, z 0 to 0.1) instead of hanging past the running boards. Tuned by eye on Frost Basin.
notes.cockpitEye: A seated head height over the driver's hips (0.86 m above the saddle), just behind and above the handlebars, looking over the windscreen.
notes.vehicle: Handling unchanged from the Kenney sled: the new model is 0.2 m longer and 0.4 m narrower, which only changes the collision box.
